facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('There are no modern conveniences on state forest lands such as dump stations, utility hook-ups, showers, or water') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880263&siteId=29289 ('Campers are advised to bring their own water'; 'All campsites are carry in, carry out'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A single roadside site, SH001 Town Hill (Sideling Hill loop), on Welsh Road 4.56 miles from Old Route 126 (Spade Road / Crystal Springs for the first few miles). A grass parking lot that 'can hold 1 small camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents'; listed back-in, max vehicle length 55 ft, 55-ft grass driveway at a slight grade, partial shade.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880263&siteId=29289 ('Max Vehicle Length: 55', 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Driveway Surface: Grass', 'Driveway Length: 55', 'Grass parking lot that can hold 1 small camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents', 'Located on Welsh Road, 4.56 miles from Route Old 126'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A permit and reservation are always required, on the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests reservation site or 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/buchanan/camping ('A permit and reservation is always required for motorized, roadside camping', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880263&siteId=29289 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific', 'Checkin Time: 3:00 pm'), read 2026-10-20

note: Buchanan State Forest motorized roadside site SH001 Town Hill (Sideling Hill area), on Welsh Road 4.56 miles from Old Route 126: a secluded grass parking lot for one small camper or two vehicles with tents (listed back-in, up to 55 ft), with road noise from I-70. No water, hookups, toilets or trash service (carry in, carry out). Permit and reservation always required; district office 717-485-3148. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single back-in grass-lot site listed to 55 ft ('1 small camper trailer'), reservation always required (fcfs never), open year round. Note rewritten as clean prose with the location. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
